What usage past your plan costs.

On Starter and Pro, page views, form submissions, and site storage past the amount your plan includes are metered at our infrastructure cost plus a 30% margin, after card fees. Video, audio, file downloads and other media served from our servers count 1.6× toward bandwidth, because serving them costs more than serving pages. You are not cut off when you go past a band — the overage is itemized on your invoice.

Free plans are capped rather than billed, and Custom usage is set by your agreement. Dataset storage, API requests, email sends, CRM records and workflow runs are separate add-ons, priced in the table above. The CRM is included from Starter, and Free does not include it.

cells: Simple page (contact, reviews, an account page)

Managed: your plan plus Site Care, one price. Managed Starter is $74 a month, or $65 a month billed yearly. Extra work past the hour is $79 per started hour, once you've said yes. Bigger jobs are priced flat up front, from the project prices above.
What Aglyn takes on a sale.

This is on top of Stripe's processing fee (2.9% + 30¢ on most online card sales), which Stripe bills to your own Stripe account at its standard rates. Services, including appointment bookings and reservations, are charged at the digital rate. The Aglyn percentage steps down as you move up the plans. If you sell physical goods, moving from Starter to Pro pays for itself on the fee alone once sales pass about $3,300 a month, on yearly billing. Selling through the Aglyn marketplace is separate from the rates above and does not step down with your plan: Aglyn keeps 20% of a marketplace listing sale on every paid plan, and 30% on Free.

records.name: qa
cells: What happens if I exceed a plan limit?

Storage, API calls, email sends and, on Pro, workflow runs keep working: usage past your allowance is metered at the rates in the usage table and itemized on your invoice. AI credits past your included band are metered the same way, per 1,000, unless you set a stop or a monthly ceiling in Billing — and on Free they stop at the band. Sites, seats, and datasets stop at your limit until you buy an add-on or upgrade, and on Starter, CRM records stop at 10,000 and API requests at 20,000 a month until you move to Pro. On Free, email stops at 300 a month and starts again on the 1st; sign-in links, verification, invitations, password resets and security notices always go out.

records.name: qa
cells: Every paid plan includes a monthly band of AI credits, and every Aglyn AI action draws on it, generation included. For more, add AI credits to any paid plan, per workspace: 5,000 credits for $10 a month, as many blocks as you need up to 30, on top of the plan’s own; Custom by agreement. Credits past the band are billed per 1,000 at the rate in the usage table. If you’d rather it stopped, turn on Stop AI assist at the included band in Billing, or set a monthly dollar ceiling on overage. Free includes 300 credits a month and stops there — nothing is billed.

records.name: qa
cells: Payments run on Stripe. Aglyn adds a transaction fee on top of Stripe’s processing — 0–3% depending on plan and what you sell: physical goods on the lower rate, digital products and services (bookings included) on the higher one. It steps down as you move up — 1% digital and nothing on physical goods on Pro, 0% on Custom.

records.name: qa
cells: Can I self-host instead of subscribing?
Yes. Aglyn is Apache-2.0 — run it yourself with Docker and your own Firebase project (see the self-hosting guide), or use the hosted platform and skip the ops.

records.name: qa
cells: Can I change or cancel anytime?

Upgrade, downgrade, or cancel whenever you like from the billing page. Upgrades and downgrades are prorated as a charge or credit on your next invoice, and a canceled plan stays active until the end of the billing period you've already paid for.

records.name: qa
cells: Apply it at checkout — promotion codes work on any paid plan and show up itemized on your invoice.

records.name: qa
cells: Do you offer SSO or an SLA?

SAML / OIDC single sign-on is available on Custom plans today — you set it up yourself in the console after proving your domain. Custom plans also include dedicated support with a named manager and a 24–48 hour first response. We do not offer a contractual uptime SLA.

records.name: qa
cells: How much does it cost to build a website on Aglyn?

Nothing to build and publish on the free plan: one site, up to five pages, forms, media and AI credits. Your own domain, the store, bookings and the CRM come with Starter; the pricing page lists every plan.

records.name: qa
cells: Is the free plan a trial?
No. It does not expire or downgrade. It is capped rather than billed: one site, five pages, 250 MB of storage, 2 GB of bandwidth and 300 emails a month.

records.name: qa
cells: Aglyn is a website builder with the store, forms, CRM, email, analytics and Aglyn AI built in. It is open source and free to start.

records.name: qa
cells: How does Aglyn compare to alternatives?

We keep a side-by-side breakdown for each one — pricing, the limits behind the pricing, and what the other platform does better. Every competitor figure is dated and taken from that vendor's own pricing or help pages.
